xmldoc.short_description: Decode a length-delimited stream given in pieces.

param_input_item.param_description: a schema from protobuf.load and a message type.
the decode options kept for the whole stream: 'Layout', 'Fields', 'Where', 'WellKnownTypes', 'EnumsAsText', 'FillDefaults', 'MissingAsNaN', 'OnError', 'KeepUnknown', as protobuf.decode.
d.push: a piece of the stream, of any size (uint8).

param_output_item.param_description: d.push: the number of records decoded and of records dropped by this push.
d.read: the records decoded since the last read, as protobuf.decode. report has PendingBytes, the size of the incomplete record waiting for the next push.

description.p: protobuf.Decoder decodes a length-delimited stream that arrives in pieces, for example while a file or a socket is read. Each push decodes the complete records in the bytes it has so far; the bytes of a record cut at the end of a piece wait for the next push. read returns the records decoded since the last read.
Because only complete records are kept and the rest waits, a large stream is processed block by block with a bounded amount of memory.
